_meta.author: OpenAI ChatGPT for Peter Higgins
_meta.purpose: Structured registry of EITT operational, diagnostic, companion, and control-layer components.

registry_policy.core_rule: EITT is the primary instrument. Slope, velocity, vertex-distance, and trajectory efficiency are companion diagnostics. F17 and operating-envelope elements are control-layer components.

layer_definitions.operation: Transforms or computes on the compositional carrier.
layer_definitions.primary_diagnostic: Directly reads entropy invariance, pass/fail, lock range, or related primary EITT outputs.
layer_definitions.companion_diagnostic: Adds interpretation without rewriting the primary EITT signal.
layer_definitions.control_layer: Checks trust, contamination, detectability, safe use, or release integrity.

components.output: Closed composition x(t) on the simplex
components.purpose: Maps raw observables into a valid compositional carrier for EITT and CoDa analysis.
failure_mode: Non-compositional source variables treated as composition

components.purpose: Measures compositional evenness at native resolution.
failure_mode: Entropy read as channel uncertainty instead of compositional evenness

components.input: Ordered compositional time series and block size M
components.purpose: Performs natural simplex coarse-graining while preserving compositional structure.
failure_mode: Arithmetic averaging substituted for geometric averaging
Too few blocks for valid comparison

components.purpose: Converts blocked compositions into entropy-ready distributions.

components.input: Blocked entropies across all valid blocks at scale M
components.output: Single EITT signal per scale M
components.purpose: Produces the scale-dependent entropy summary used by the EITT test.
Moves simplex data into CoDa log-ratio coordinates for motion and spread diagnostics.
failure_mode: CLR used without acknowledging sum-to-zero structure

components.formula: ilr(x) = orthonormal balance coordinates derived from x
components.purpose: Provides orthonormal CoDa coordinates for structural analysis and balance-based diagnostics.
failure_mode: Promotion of basis-dependent result as universal

components.purpose: Measures compositional spread and serves as the main structural bridge metric from CoDa into EITT reasoning.

components.input: Native mean entropy H_bar(1) and decimated mean entropy H_bar(M)
components.output: Absolute entropy change by scale M
components.purpose: Primary diagnostic of entropy preservation under geometric decimation.
failure_mode: Sub-noise-floor deltas misread as strong confirmation
Boundary cases mistaken for clean passes

components.output: Relative entropy deviation at scale M
components.purpose: Core pass/fail quantity for the EITT test.
failure_mode: Threshold treated as universal without envelope context
Noisy low-power data treated as decisive

components.formula: pass_rate = (# tested M satisfying threshold) / (# tested M)
components.input: Relative EITT values across tested M
components.purpose: Pass 1 legitimacy classifier and compact summary of scale robustness.
failure_mode: Marginal cases forced into binary labels

components.formula: classification state rather than numeric formula
components.input: Relative EITT, power, noise, block count, envelope state
components.purpose: Allows the instrument to report 'cannot resolve' rather than forcing success or failure.
Reads lock behavior: flat means in lock, rising means losing lock, steep means free-running or weakly constrained.
failure_mode: Sparse M grid produces unstable slopes

components.formula: M_break = first M where threshold is exceeded
components.purpose: Measures how far a system can be coarse-grained before invariance fails.
failure_mode: Confusion between M_break, last pass, and max tested M
Low-power fake extension of lock range

components.purpose: Measures how fast the composition is moving between adjacent observations.
failure_mode: High-frequency jitter mistaken for meaningful motion
Invalid CLR path due to zero issues

components.purpose: Detects approach to degeneracy / edge risk even when entropy still looks acceptable.
failure_mode: Boundary drift hidden by acceptable EITT

components.purpose: Distinguishes purposeful drift from wandering or oscillatory motion.

components.formula: Combined interpretation of EITT + velocity + vertex-distance + trajectory efficiency
components.purpose: Prevents overreliance on a single scalar reading.

components.input: Geometric and arithmetic decimation results at the same M
components.purpose: Integrity alarm for arithmetic-vs-geometric divergence, anomalous coupling, or stored-energy style contamination.
failure_mode: Used as replacement for EITT rather than control layer
False comfort if isolated from context

components.purpose: Makes the F17 contamination gap more comparable across systems with different spread.

components.formula: Compare observed delta_M to empirical SE(M) and SNR thresholds
components.purpose: Separates small measured deviations from truly detectable deviations.

components.formula: Require adequate N/M and tested-scale support
components.input: Observation count N and tested M schedule
components.purpose: Prevents fake certainty from scales with inadequate block support.
failure_mode: Low-power M treated as normal evidence

components.formula: Deliberate contamination and correction stress tests
components.purpose: Tests whether cosmetic improvement is actually contamination rather than valid correction.
failure_mode: No separation between attack outcomes and core signal

components.formula: Re-run prior DUT chain after any modification
components.input: Updated method and historical DUT suite
components.purpose: Prevents forward-only changes from corrupting earlier validated behavior.
